sections.theory:
9.3.3 Components of the total sum of squares (equal sample size)

In one way analysis of variance the total variation present in the observed data may be due to two meaningful components i.e. (i) variation among treatments (samples) (ii) variation with in the samples, so the T.S.S is divided in to two components as:

\text{T.S.S}=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\sum_{i=1}^{r}(x_{ij}-\overline{x}_{..})^2

=\text{within SS}+\text{Treatment SS}

To obtain unbiased estimates for \sigma^2 divide both sides by respective degrees of freedom to have

S_T^2=S_e^2+S_{Tr}^2

\text{Or MST}=\text{MSE}+\text{MSTr}

The F-Test is defined as F=\frac{\text{MSTr}}{\text{MSE}} with (\nu_1=k-1 and \nu_2=n-k) df. which is used for testing H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2=\ldots=\mu_k verses

H_1: Not all means are equal.

H_0 is rejected when, F_c\ge F_{\alpha,(\nu_1,\nu_2)}, whereas F_{\alpha,(\nu_1,\nu_2)} is obtained from the percentage points of the F-distribution, Table 9.1.

9.3.4 Components of the total degrees of freedom

When the total sum of squares is partitioned into component parts then the total degrees of freedom can also be partitioned into component parts accordingly as below:

(n-1)=(n-k)+(k-1)

\text{Total df}=\text{within df}+\text{between df}

9.3.3 مربعوں کے کل مجموعے کے اجزاء (برابر نمونہ سائز)

یک طرفہ تجزیۂ تغیر میں مشاہدہ شدہ مواد میں موجود کل تغیر دو بامعنی اجزاء کی وجہ سے ہو سکتا ہے یعنی (i) علاج (نمونوں) کے درمیان تغیر (ii) نمونوں کے اندر تغیر، لہٰذا T.S.S کو دو اجزاء میں یوں تقسیم کیا جاتا ہے:

\text{T.S.S}=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\sum_{i=1}^{r}(x_{ij}-\overline{x}_{..})^2

=\text{within SS}+\text{Treatment SS}

\sigma^2 کے غیر جانبدار تخمینے حاصل کرنے کے لیے دونوں اطراف کو متعلقہ درجاتِ آزادی سے تقسیم کریں تاکہ

S_T^2=S_e^2+S_{Tr}^2

\text{Or MST}=\text{MSE}+\text{MSTr}

F-جانچ کی تعریف F=\frac{\text{MSTr}}{\text{MSE}} ہے جس کے (\nu_1=k-1 اور \nu_2=n-k) درجاتِ آزادی ہیں، جو H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2=\ldots=\mu_k کی جانچ کے لیے استعمال ہوتی ہے بمقابلہ

H_1: تمام اوسط برابر نہیں۔

H_0 رد کیا جاتا ہے جب F_c\ge F_{\alpha,(\nu_1,\nu_2)}، جبکہ F_{\alpha,(\nu_1,\nu_2)} کو F-تقسیم کے فیصدی نقاط، جدول 9.1 سے حاصل کیا جاتا ہے۔

9.3.4 کل درجاتِ آزادی کے اجزاء

جب مربعوں کے کل مجموعے کو اجزاء میں تقسیم کیا جائے تو کل درجاتِ آزادی کو بھی اسی کے مطابق اجزاء میں یوں تقسیم کیا جا سکتا ہے:

(n-1)=(n-k)+(k-1)

\text{Total df}=\text{within df}+\text{between df}

sections.content:
9.3.3 Components of the total sum of squares (equal sample size)

In one way analysis of variance the total variation present in the observed data may be due to two meaningful components i.e. (i) variation among treatments (samples) (ii) variation with in the samples, so the T.S.S is divided in to two components as:

ext{T.S.S}=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\sum_{i=1}^{r}(x_{ij}-\overline{x}_{..})^2

= ext{within SS}+ ext{Treatment SS}

To obtain unbiased estimates for \sigma^2 divide both sides by respective degrees of freedom to have

S_T^2=S_e^2+S_{Tr}^2

ext{Or MST}= ext{MSE}+ ext{MSTr}

The F-Test is defined as F= rac{ ext{MSTr}}{ ext{MSE}} with ( u_1=k-1 and u_2=n-k) df. which is used for testing H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2=\ldots=\mu_k verses

H_1: Not all means are equal.

H_0 is rejected when, F_c\ge F_{\alpha,( u_1, u_2)}, whereas F_{\alpha,( u_1, u_2)} is obtained from the percentage points of the F-distribution, Table 9.1.

9.3.4 Components of the total degrees of freedom

When the total sum of squares is partitioned into component parts then the total degrees of freedom can also be partitioned into component parts accordingly as below:

(n-1)=(n-k)+(k-1)

ext{Total df}= ext{within df}+ ext{between df}
